post.caption:
A package saved two hours in month one. In month five it cost four days. 📦

Nobody reviews one line in pubspec.yaml. It spreads into three features. Eleven days before launch, its licence turns out to be one the store build cannot ship. The licence did not grow. The spread did.

Four agents for what you chose to install:
📦 Dependencies: count imports per package. In a real Flutter app, uuid was imported by zero files.
⚖️ Licences: the deny list is a hook on the resolved tree. Transitive packages ship too.
🎨 Copyright: no asset without a source in ATTRIBUTIONS.md.
🔒 Privacy: the store declaration is derived from a data inventory, checked against the rules.

Full article: blog.msdevbuild.com/blog/ai-agents-dependency-license-copyright-privacy
